item.title: Water Utility Planning for Customer Equity Outcomes
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in Utilities Policy focuses on how water utilities can incorporate equity considerations into their planning and operations to achieve better outcomes for customers. The issue seeks research examining the intersection of water utility management and customer equity.

Appel publié par Utilities Policy. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
